title: Jaunts menu: filter by school grade
items: A row of grade pills under the jaunt groups (All, 3–5, 6–8, 9–10) shows only the jaunts written for those grades; Clear filters lets it go.
The grades 3–5 Glessner tour is named The Glessner Household, like the tour it retells; its Grades 3–5 tag tells them apart.
